title: Slushie Bar Salts White Pear Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: White Pear Ice from Slushie Bar Salts is an exquisite e-liquid that elegantly marries the gentle sweetness of White Pear with a crisp icy undertone. This Nic Salt blend is a serene and refreshing vaping experience, capturing the subtle flavours of ripe pears with a cool twist. The e-liquid opens with the light and sweet flavour of White Pear, delivering a smooth and refined taste that is both refreshing and comforting. The natural sweetness of the pear is delicate yet pronounced, creating a soothing and enjoyable inhale. This is then elevated by the addition of a cool icy element, bringing an invigorating and crisp dimension to the vape. The coolness perfectly complements the pear, adding a fresh finish that cleanses the palate. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
